description:
Returns a list of Recycled Document Revisions with permissions.

Defaults to most recently recycled first (`recycled_at` descending, with an `id` descending tie-break) when no `sort` is supplied.

Pass `view=ids_only` to receive an array of Document Revision ids instead of full objects. Unlike the default view, `ids_only` does not apply serializer-level per-record permission masking. Normal requests remain scoped by the caller's permission groups; with `filters[id]` or `filters[ids]`, the recycle bin view permission is the access boundary.
